changes: p1: changed the name from 'Śaṅkarācārya' to 'Śaṅkara'. 'ācārya' is already listed under titles, so keeping it in the name doubled it up. The author attribution is still only the traditional one.

notes: The catalogue gives the date as ŚS 1676 (about 1754 CE), but the colophon as transcribed reads śrīśāke 1776 (about 1854 CE). One of the two is probably a typo. This record follows the transcription. The ending -ṇā in gopālaśarmma[ṇā] was added by the cataloguer.
